what_happened: Declaration-level import-edge classification done mechanically: an Expr.getUsedConstants probe over the built oleans plus env.header.moduleData gave a whole-repo (module, used-module) table in 7s, and a python simulation of candidate import edits flagged the single module needing a new explicit Mathlib import before any compile. A shadow olean root (symlinked lib dir, edited modules compiled with lean --root/-o) verified the edits without touching .lake.

Constant-level dependency probe said dropping import FormalSystem.Semantics from Automation/ProofSearch/Core.lean was safe for Termination/Fuel.lean, but the shadow compile failed with 'unknown tactic': the ring tactic (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring) reached Fuel only through the Semantics aggregator. Expr.getUsedConstants cannot see tactic/syntax provenance; the compile gate caught it and the recommendation was revised to add an explicit Mathlib.Tactic.Ring import.

The dependency probes used (ci.value?.map Expr.getUsedConstants), as written in context/project/lean4/patterns/dependency-tracing.md. On Lean v4.33.0-rc1 ConstantInfo.value? returns none for every theorem (0 of 212953 theorems had a value) unless called with (allowOpaque := true), so every probe silently ignored all proof terms. Caught only because a shadow compile failed on Finset.max' that the probe had not listed. All probes were rerun with allowOpaque := true.

Research form of R2 (drop two lines from SignedFormula.lean, add an import line to Tableau.lean) shifts every later line in two files that carry 23 file.lean:NNN citations outside specs (SignedFormula 5, Tableau 18, grep at HEAD 75dbaedcc), which check-module-invariants C20 gates; the research gate list did not cover C20 for R1-R4. Plan substitutes a line-neutral variant (SignedFormula swaps the ProofSystem aggregator import for ProofSystem.Axioms, Tableau untouched) and keeps the research form as a fallback with reanchor-lean-citations.py.

Running plan-file-scope-harvest.sh on the draft plan surfaced four coupled generated surfaces the draft had not declared (FormalSystem/README.md, FormalSystem/Automation/README.md, FormalSystem/Automation/ProofSearch/README.md, typst/generated/automation-module-map.typ); they were added to the edit phase's Files to modify before the plan was returned.

Four-root guarded build exits 1 on one module, BimodalToolsTest.CertificateImportTest (Ambiguous term closureList at lines 146 and 152, between BimodalTools.CertificateImport.closureList and FormalSystem.Metalogic.Decidability.closureList). Predates this task: the second declaration was added by commit 22e2afa46 on 2026-11-12, the test's last olean is from 2026-11-11, and default lake build and check-module-invariants C1 do not build BimodalToolsTest. File is outside task file_scope; not edited.
All fifteen post-change rebuild-set figures equal the plan's predictions; the R2 line-neutral variant built first time with no citation shift and no extra import beyond the two the report named.
